html_source: The “He” is Boylan. Bloom recalls that on the last full moon (two weeks ago Sunday), he and Boylan walked down by the Tolka River with Molly between them. Molly and Boylan were humming a song to each other and touching. We learn in Chapter 18 that Boylan squeezed her hand and she squeezed back. Later that night, Bloom “came on her bottom.”
